source: Wave 9 Step 1 (2026-06-04). WETH/USDC/USDT/WMNT addresses verified via mantlescan.xyz token tracker 2026-06-04. mETH deferred to Step 2/3 per Boss directive. Mantle is an OP-Stack-derived L2 (chainId 5000) - WETH uses Mantle's canonical 0xdead...1111 vanity dead-prefix convention; WMNT is the ERC20 wrapper of native MNT gas token.

WETH.note: Mantle canonical bridged WETH. Vanity dead-prefix address - Mantle convention for canonical assets. Verified via mantlescan token tracker.

USDC.note: Mantle USDC. Smallest address in token set, so token0=USDC in all USDC pairs (priceMode=invert for WETH/USDC and WMNT/USDC). Verified via mantlescan.

USDT.note: Mantle bridged Tether USDT. Verified via mantlescan.

WMNT.note: Wrapped Mantle. ERC20 wrapper of native MNT gas token. Verified via mantle official explorer (explorer.mantle.xyz).
